headline: ACC investigates corruption allegations against Asif Mahmud
summary: The interim government adviser is the first from his administration to face an ACC probe into recruitment and promotion irregularities at the Ministry of Youth and Sports.
details: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has launched an investigation into allegations of irregularities and corruption involving Asif Mahmud Shojib Bhuyain, an adviser to the interim government.
The probe focuses on corruption in recruitment, transfers, and promotions within the Ministry of Youth and Sports during his tenure.
Complaints allege that Tk 76 lakh was taken to cancel existing responsibilities of 38 upazila youth development officers and issue new posting orders.
Further allegations claim Tk 1.5 crore was taken for the promotion of 150 assistant upazila youth development officers, and another Tk 2 crore for preferred postings.
The ACC has formed a four-member inquiry team led by Deputy Director Md Zahid Kalam to investigate these claims.
Also under investigation are former Youth and Sports Ministry Secretary Md Mahbub-ul-Alam, former Joint Secretary Sheikh Mohammad Zobayer Hossain, and Deputy Secretary Md Masum Ahmed.
Asif Mahmud is the first adviser from the current interim government to face an ACC investigation over corruption allegations.
caption:
A first for the interim government: Asif Mahmud faces an ACC probe over allegations of multi-crore corruption.

The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has launched an investigation into allegations of irregularities and corruption involving Asif Mahmud Shojib Bhuyain, an adviser to the interim government.

The probe focuses on corruption in recruitment, transfers, and promotions within the Ministry of Youth and Sports during his tenure.

Complaints allege that Tk 76 lakh was taken to cancel existing responsibilities of 38 upazila youth development officers and issue new posting orders.

Further allegations claim Tk 1.5 crore was taken for the promotion of 150 assistant upazila youth development officers, and another Tk 2 crore for preferred postings.

The ACC has formed a four-member inquiry team led by Deputy Director Md Zahid Kalam to investigate these claims.

Also under investigation are former Youth and Sports Ministry Secretary Md Mahbub-ul-Alam, former Joint Secretary Sheikh Mohammad Zobayer Hossain, and Deputy Secretary Md Masum Ahmed.

Asif Mahmud is the first adviser from the current interim government to face an ACC investigation over corruption allegations.

headline: Dengue crisis: Five more die as 1,110 hospitalized in 24 hours
summary: The total death toll from dengue has reached 107 this year, with thousands of new admissions across all divisions of Bangladesh.
details: Five people died from dengue in the last 24 hours, according to a notice from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS). This brings the total number of deaths from the virus this year to 107.
In the same period, 1,110 new patients were admitted to hospitals. The total number of dengue patients treated in hospitals this year has now reached 38,280.
The Dhaka division reported the highest number of admissions with 440 patients, followed by Khulna with 190 and Chattogram with 175.
Other affected regions include Barishal with 110, Rajshahi with 91, Mymensingh with 65, Rangpur with 32, and Sylhet with 7 patients.
caption:
5 deaths and 1,110 hospitalizations in just 24 hours. The dengue surge continues.

Five people died from dengue in the last 24 hours, according to a notice from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS). This brings the total number of deaths from the virus this year to 107.

In the same period, 1,110 new patients were admitted to hospitals. The total number of dengue patients treated in hospitals this year has now reached 38,280.

The Dhaka division reported the highest number of admissions with 440 patients, followed by Khulna with 190 and Chattogram with 175.

Other affected regions include Barishal with 110, Rajshahi with 91, Mymensingh with 65, Rangpur with 32, and Sylhet with 7 patients.
